diagnosis.bounded_replay_cell: all four completed qd1n episodes in round 420 on Asia
diagnosis.protocol_fact: ProxyWar 0.1.8 exposes ownState.incomingAttacks as a numeric count, attacker identities in observation.combat.incomingAttackPlayerIDs, and a per-rival visiblePlayers[].incomingAttack flag.
diagnosis.source_defect: buildState read attacker identities only from ownState.incomingAttacks. A numeric count cannot identify an attacker, so incomingAttackerIDs stayed empty in current-protocol play.
disabled_existing_controls: bounded retaliation weight in land and naval target scoring
immediate revocation of reciprocal or pending-alliance protection after betrayal
attacker-aware survival alliance and pressure history
diagnosis.round_420_example: In the eliminated Asia seat-four loss, the replay resolved simultaneous Auri and daveey pressure around a 35 percent neutral expansion order. This illustrates the need for named pressure telemetry, but does not by itself prove that attribution caused the loss.
diagnosis.causal_hypothesis: Wiring the current protocol attacker IDs into the existing hostility model will redirect legal counterpressure without adding a new broad selector and will improve matched Asia conversion.

candidate_change.description: Merge attacker IDs from combat.incomingAttackPlayerIDs, visible-player incomingAttack flags, and legacy structured incomingAttacks values; retain the numeric count for threat cadence.
candidate_change.marker_meaning: the selected rival attack targets a currently attributed incoming attacker
candidate_change.scope: one protocol adapter path, one observability marker, and two regression tests
candidate_change.public_text: existing short leetspeak reason with :ia1 suffix

red_regression.name: current protocol attacker ids activate immediate retaliation

parent_image.note: workshop parent at the current source baseline, not the exact live v77 image

verdict.reason: The candidate has clean two-orientation Asia advantages against both the workshop parent and an attribution-only exact-live-v77 parent, but World/Pangaea and the hosted 4/4 plus 20/20 map-and-seat gates are still open.
verdict.source_action: retain the implementation as the leading workshop arm
verdict.next_test: Run World/Pangaea mirrored cells against exact live v77, then the full 4/4 and 20/20 gates before any production-architecture upload.
